findings.message: Detected 2 matching img entries with the same source/start/duration.
findings.fixHint: Avoid duplicated media nodes that can be discovered twice during compilation.

findings.message: <div id="bg"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div>. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="bg"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: Two text blocks overlap and may render unreadable.
findings.fixHint: Give each block its own zone, or put data-layout-allow-overlap on the text or on a container inside the scene. A marker on the scene root does not apply.
